- Films: One Summer Love, Dragonfly, Bang the Drum Slowly, Alice, Sweet Alice, Red Riding Hood, The Emperor's New Clothes, The Tale of Peter Rabbit
- People: Gilbert Cates, N. Richard Nash, Beau Bridges, Susan Sarandon, Mildred Dunnock, Ann Wedgeworth, Stephen J. Lawrence, Marlo Thomas, Robert De Niro, Isabella Rossellini, Craig T. Nelson, Sid Caesar, Robert Morse, Carol Burnett, Michael Korie, Sheldon Harnick, Helen Reddy
- Songs and music projects: One Way Ticket, Free to Be... You and Me, You Take My Breath Away, Sesame Street
- Awards and organizations: Emmy Awards, Peabody Award, Paris International Festival of Fantasy and Science Fiction, HBO, ABC

Facts:
- In 1967, "One Way Ticket" was co-written by American composer Stephen J. Lawrence and became Helen Reddy's first hit single.
- In 1976, One Summer Love, originally titled Dragonfly, was released as a romantic drama film directed by Gilbert Cates from a screenplay by N. Richard Nash.
- In 1976, One Summer Love starred Beau Bridges and Susan Sarandon and featured Mildred Dunnock and Ann Wedgeworth.
- In 1976, Stephen J. Lawrence composed the score for One Summer Love, also known as Dragonfly.
- Ann Wedgeworth, born January 21, 1934, is an American character actress known for playing Lana Shields in Three's Company and Merleen Elldridge in Evening Shade.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed more than 300 songs and scores for Sesame Street and won three Emmy Awards for Outstanding Achievement in Music Direction and Composition for that work.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the title song and four other songs for Marlo Thomas's Free to Be... You and Me, which became a million-selling record, book, and Emmy Award- and Peabody Award-winning ABC television special.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the million-selling Gold Record "You Take My Breath Away," scored Bang the Drum Slowly and Alice, Sweet Alice, and Alice, Sweet Alice won the music award at the Paris International Festival of Fantasy and Science Fiction.
- Stephen J. Lawrence later composed the songs and score for the 1989 live-action movie musical Red Riding Hood, with lyrics by Michael Korie, and also composed music for The Emperor's New Clothes and HBO's The Tale of Peter Rabbit, whose lyrics were by Sheldon Harnick.
